description: This file defines the ProjectDashboardController class for managing project-related dashboard actions within a web application. It includes methods for project lifecycle management such as editing overview, images, costs, rewards, support, investments, analytics, story, and pitch handling, as well as actions for submitting projects for review or deletion. The class interacts with various models, forms, and external services to facilitate project management workflows in the application.

classes.name: ProjectDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard actions related to projects, including editing, viewing, submitting, and supporting projects.

methods.name: createProjectSidebar
methods.description: Static method to build and attach the project sidebar menu based on project state and user permissions.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Validates and loads a project instance, checking user permissions.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Displays a list of user's projects.

methods.name: summaryAction
methods.description: Displays project summary in the dashboard.

methods.name: getEditRedirect
methods.description: Determines next redirect after editing steps based on validation state.

methods.name: overviewAction
methods.description: Handles editing of project overview details.

methods.name: imagesAction
methods.description: Handles editing of project images.

methods.name: updatesAction
methods.description: Displays list of project updates (blog posts).

methods.name: updatesEditAction
methods.description: Handles editing of an individual project update (blog post).

methods.name: costsAction
methods.description: Handles editing of project costs.

methods.name: rewardsAction
methods.description: Handles editing of project rewards.

methods.name: applyAction
methods.description: Submits the project for review to go live.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Deletes a project if permitted.

methods.name: campaignAction
methods.description: Handles editing of project campaign details.

methods.name: supportsAction
methods.description: Manages the support/partnership section for the project.

methods.name: investsAction
methods.description: Displays list of investments in the project.

methods.name: analyticsAction
methods.description: Handles project analytics form and display.

methods.name: materialsAction
methods.description: Displays shared materials related to project social commitments.

methods.name: storyAction
methods.description: Handles editing of project story.

methods.name: pitchAction
methods.description: Manages actions associated with project pitches.
